Education | U.S. Representative Education is critical to success in the future, and it is an integral part of every American’s life.&nbsp; I believe every parent should have the right to choose where they send their children to school.&nbsp; I’m a proud cosponsor of the Parents Bill of Rights Act to protect parental involvement in education by reinforcing their right to be heard.&nbsp; Congress must work to ensure the success of all students, parents, workers, job creators, and families.</p> <p>The American university system is the pride of the world and produces some of the brightest minds.&nbsp; However, we should encourage those whose calling steers them in a different direction to continue their education at trade schools and community colleges, another crucial part of our education system, and one that deserves more investment.</p>" /> Skip to Content Education Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email Education is critical to success in the future, and it is an integral part of every American’s life.  I believe every parent should have the right to choose where they send their children to school.  I’m a proud cosponsor of the Parents Bill of Rights Act to protect parental involvement in education by reinforcing their right to be heard.  Congress must work to ensure the success of all students, parents, workers, job creators, and families. The American university system is the pride of the world and produces some of the brightest minds.  However, we should encourage those whose calling steers them in a different direction to continue their education at trade schools and community colleges, another crucial part of our education system, and one that deserves more investment. Health Care | U.S. Representative Every American deserves access to high quality, affordable healthcare.&nbsp; Thousands of families across our nation – and especially in the 7<sup>th</sup> Congressional District which includes rural Southeastern North Carolina – are affected by access to affordable healthcare.&nbsp; In order to tackle these challenges, Congress must enact reforms that lower costs, improve quality, and strengthen accessibility.</p> <p>There are many flaws with our current healthcare system, including access to care and increasing prescription drug costs.&nbsp; Congress must continue to have extensive discussion and debate on the best plan for reforming our healthcare system.&nbsp; The American people deserve a solution, and we must create a framework for competition and transparency that will foster a healthcare system that provides the very best care at the lowest possible price.</p> <p>As a co-founder of the Congressional Primary Care Caucus, I believe in the importance of preventative and primary care as a way to improve patient outcomes and curtail the cost of care in the future.&nbsp; I am also a proud advocate of robust funding for Community Health Centers, which provide high quality, cost effective primary care to underserved communities.</p> <p>Additionally, the Coronavirus pandemic showed us that if we don’t protect our right to make our own healthcare decisions, government agencies and large private sector entities will take them from us.&nbsp; We must remove government bureaucrats from healthcare decisions and protect our healthcare freedom.&nbsp; Your healthcare should be determined by you and your doctor(s) — not a government bureaucrat.</p>" /> Skip to Content Health Care Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email Every American deserves access to high quality, affordable healthcare.  Thousands of families across our nation – and especially in the 7 th Congressional District which includes rural Southeastern North Carolina – are affected by access to affordable healthcare.  In order to tackle these challenges, Congress must enact reforms that lo

Transportation | U.S. Representative Southeastern North Carolina is a critical hub for our region and the nation.&nbsp; With an international airport, deep water port, and interstate highways, Southeastern North Carolina is well connected to the rest of the country and the world. &nbsp;<br /> <br /> Our infrastructure is the lifeblood of our communities, providing for tens of thousands of jobs in the tourism, trade, and construction industries.&nbsp; Improving our roads, airports, beaches, waterways and ports are top priorities.&nbsp; I’m proud to serve as a subcommittee ranking member on the House Transportation and Infrastructure Committee.&nbsp; My leadership position enables me to better advocate for policies that help our area continue to grow and thrive.<br /> <br /> <a href="https://rouzer.house.gov/statements-of-support/" target="_blank">Dalilah's Law Statements of Support</a></p> <br />" /> Skip to Content Transportation Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email Southeastern North Carolina is a critical hub for our region and the nation.  With an international airport, deep water port, and interstate highways, Southeastern North Carolina is well connected to the rest of the country and the world.   Our infrastructure is the lifeblood of our communities, providing for tens of thousands of jobs in the tourism, trade, and construction industries.  Improving our roads, airports, beaches, waterways and ports are top priorities.  I’m proud to serve as a subcommittee ranking member on the House Transportation and Infrastructure Committee.  My leadership position enables me to better advocate for policies that help our area continue to grow and thrive. Agriculture | U.S. Representative Since our nation’s founding, agriculture has been a key component of our economy and success.&nbsp; Agriculture has always been the dominant industry in North Carolina and currently contributes $111.1 billion to our state’s economy, far outpacing any other industry in economic output.&nbsp;</p> <p>For generations, North Carolina farm families have fed and clothed the world.&nbsp; Our nutrient rich soil and moderate climate provide desirable growing conditions to raise crops like cotton, peanuts, soybeans, sweet potatoes, and tobacco among many others.&nbsp; I'm proud to serve on the House Agriculture Committee and as a co-founder of the Congressional Agri-tourism Caucus.</p> <p>Now, more than ever, America’s farm families are facing a great deal of uncertainty.&nbsp; With a looming global food shortage, historic inflation, record fertilizer, record fuel costs and other input prices skyrocketing reauthorization of the Farm Bill in 2023 could not come at a more crucial time.&nbsp; Through my leadership on the House Agriculture Committee, I will continue to work to ensure North Carolina farm families have the support they need to continue to feed America and the world.&nbsp; Important programs including crop insurance, healthy meals for low-income families, improving economic opportunity in rural America, animal disease prevention, and promoting research and extension services for our producers will be among some of the main items considered in this legislation.</p>" /> Skip to Content Agriculture Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email Since our nation’s founding, agriculture has been a key component of our economy and success.  Agriculture has always been the dominant industry in North Carolina and currently contributes $111.1 billion to our state’s economy, far outpacing any other industry in economic output.  For generations, North Carolina farm families have fed and clothed the world.  Our nutrient rich soil and moderate climate provide desirable growing conditions to raise crops like cotton, peanuts, soybeans, sweet potatoes, and tobacco a

Coastal | U.S. Representative North Carolina’s 7th Congressional District is fortunate to have some of the most beautiful beaches in the United States which drive significant job growth and economic activity for our local coastal communities.&nbsp; We also count on our coastline as the first line of defense against powerful storms, and consistent beach re-nourishment projects are key to limiting the beach and structural damages these major storms would otherwise cause that would cost taxpayers much, much more on the backend.&nbsp; &nbsp;<br /> <br /> I am proud to be recognized as a Federal Champion by the American Flood Coalition for my record as a longtime advocate helping our communities in Southeastern North Carolina recover from major hurricanes and flooding.</p>" /> Skip to Content Coastal Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email North Carolina’s 7th Congressional District is fortunate to have some of the most beautiful beaches in the United States which drive significant job growth and economic activity for our local coastal communities.  We also count on our coastline as the first line of defense against powerful storms, and consistent beach re-nourishment projects are key to limiting the beach and structural damages these major storms would otherwise cause that would cost taxpayers much, much more on the backend.    I am proud to be recognized as a Federal Champion by the American Flood Coalition for my record as a longtime advocate helping our communities in Southeastern North Carolina recover from major hurricanes and flooding.
